en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate exhibition hall in Secession/Art Nouveau style, with towers at each end and a decorative façade featuring multiple clover-shaped windows and arches. In front of the building are planted young trees and several tall flagpoles bearing long vertical flags. There are low hills in the background. Red printed Hungarian text appears at the top, and a large purple handwritten signature is across the sky area.
